label: Reply to an incoming message
info: Answers every private message that arrives on your number.

name: Setup
info: Open the Turbo Notify account node, paste an API key with the messages:send and events:read scopes and press Test. The events node checks for new messages every 30 seconds. The first check after a deploy only remembers the newest event, so old messages are not answered. Replying automatically sends real messages from your number: answer only people who expect it.
